fossestien.title: Fossestien
fossestien.miniTitle: Hiking along river and waterfalls in Gaular
fossestien.text_part_1:
Fossestien is a beautiful 21 km hiking route with a height difference of about 500 metres, running from Gaularfjellet down to Viksdalen. This is a moderate and hilly hike where good hiking shoes are necessary, and the trail is not suitable for cycling or riding.
You can start the hike wherever suits you best, and it is well marked with maps and parking facilities at four locations: Tornesstølen, Longestølen, Likholefossen and Eldal. This makes it easy to tailor the hike to your time and preferences.
For those who need it, transport services are also available from Hov Hyttegrend at a cost. Transport must be arranged no later than the day before so everything can be planned well.
fossestien.text_part_2:
Along Fossestien you walk through varied and lively nature, alternating between forest paths, wooden bridges and rocky sections by the river. The trail follows old travel routes that have been used by both people and animals for generations. Along the way you encounter 14 waterfalls and 7 lakes, as well as several mountain farms – one of them is still in active use today. In the lower part of the valley, the route passes through a narrow ravine that resembles a small canyon with steep mountain sides.
The hike offers a real nature experience where you get close to the landscape, wildlife and birdlife, and to an active cultural landscape shaped by farming. At the same time, Fossestien runs along a main branch of the Gaularvassdrag, a river that was permanently protected in 1993 after years of conservation struggles. This makes the area especially special and gives a unique insight into Norwegian nature and nature conservation in practice.

fishing.title: Fishing in Viksdalen
fishing.text_part_1:
Here you have nature and fishing experiences right outside your door, with a short distance from accommodation to rivers, lakes and mountains that invite you to peace, activity and nature-based experiences.
Viksdalen is especially known for its magnificent western Norwegian nature, with deep valleys, lush slopes and crystal-clear rivers winding through the landscape. Here you will find a varied water system with good populations of trout, and fishing can range from calm mountain lakes high up in the mountains to more active river stretches lower down in the valley.
The Gaularvassdrag is one of the best-known river systems in western Norway and offers exciting fishing experiences throughout the season. The river is known for its natural variation, with pools, rapids and calm sections that provide different challenges and experiences depending on weather, water flow and season. For many, this variation is precisely what makes fishing here so attractive.
fishing.text_part_2:
In addition to river fishing, you will find many quiet mountain lakes around Viksdalen, where you can start the day in complete peace – perhaps with mirror-like water, morning mist and only the sound of birds and wind. These lakes are perfect for a more relaxed fishing trip, or for combining fishing with walking in easy or more demanding terrain.
What makes fishing in Viksdalen especially special is not only the catch itself, but the whole experience around it. The pure mountain air, the sound of running water, and the feeling of being far from everyday stress create a setting that many experience as both relaxing and renewing. Here, the trip is just as much about being present in nature as about catching fish.
Here you can buy fishing permits and get good, up-to-date information about fishing spots, seasons, water flow and local conditions. We are happy to share tips about good starting points, short day trips or longer hikes into the mountains, so you can make the most of your stay – regardless of experience and interest.

mountainHike.title: Mountain hikes
mountainHike.text_part_1:
The nature around the area is something very special to us. Here you will find high mountains, quiet lakes, green valleys and hiking trails that take you close to the true western Norwegian nature. From Hov Hyttegrend you have the mountains right outside your door, and the possibilities for good nature experiences are many – whether you want a quiet family walk or a longer day hike into the mountains.
Many of the finest hikes start only a short distance from our cabins. On the way you meet rushing rivers, fresh mountain air and views that make you want to stop a little longer. It is not only about reaching the top, but about the experiences along the way and the calm you find in nature.
The mountains in the area mean a lot to us, and therefore we have named all our cabins after mountain peaks in Viksdalen. Each cabin has its own name and its own connection to the nature around us. It is our way of bringing history, landscape and local identity into your stay with us.
mountainHike.text_part_2:
For inspiration, hiking suggestions and maps, we recommend the app and website UT.no, where you will find many beautiful hikes in and around Viksdalen. Here you can easily plan hikes according to level and length.
We are happy to help with suggestions for hikes that suit both families, beginners and more experienced mountain walkers. Whether you want to experience sunrise from a mountain peak or simply enjoy a quiet evening in nature, you will find hikes for all levels in Viksdalen.

swimming.title: Swimming / bathing
swimming.text_part_1:
For us, swimming and bathing are a natural part of the summer experience. Here you can start the day with fresh mountain air and end it with a refreshing dip in clear, clean water close to the cabins.
Around Hov Hyttegrend and in Viksdalen you will find several lovely swimming spots in rivers and lakes, surrounded by beautiful western Norwegian nature. The water comes from mountains and glaciers and gives a fresh and authentic experience that many appreciate on warm summer days.
This is a peaceful area where you can really let your shoulders drop. Whether you want a quiet dip, play in the water with the family or simply enjoy the view from the shore, everything is set up for great summer days in nature.

frisbeeGolf.title: Frisbee golf in Eldalen
frisbeeGolf.text_part_1:
In Eldalen, only about 8 km from Hov Hyttegrend, you will find a lovely frisbee golf course in beautiful western Norwegian nature. Here you can combine activity and nature experience in a simple and social way.
The course is well laid out in the landscape and takes you through varied terrain with forest, open areas and beautiful views along the way. This creates a pleasant and natural round that suits both beginners and more experienced players.
Frisbee golf in Eldalen is an activity that suits the whole family, groups of friends and anyone who wants to do something fun outdoors in fresh air. It requires little equipment, and you decide the pace yourself – perfect for a relaxed and active holiday day.
With the short distance from Hov Hyttegrend, this is an easily accessible offer that gives you an extra experience during your stay in the area.
